Title: 香草烤雞 (Herb Roasted Chicken)

Ingredients:
- 5 whole chickens (approx 1.5 kg each)
- Olive oil
- Salt, pepper
- Garlic cloves
- Fresh rosemary, thyme, oregano
- Lemon
- Butter
- Optional: carrots, potatoes, onions

Steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
2. Clean chickens, pat dry.
3. Season inside and out with salt, pepper, garlic, herbs.
4. Stuff cavity with lemon halves, herbs.
5. Tie legs, tuck wings.
6. Rub skin with olive oil and butter.
7. Roast for 45-50 min per chicken or until internal temp 75°C.
8. Rest 10 min before carving.
